title: Fastned - Polestar 2 78 kWh (2020-2023) charge graph
notes: Charge graph data embedded in the Fastned vehicle page (150+ kW charger class); per-percent values 7-93 %. Fastned says curves assume a battery near 30 C. Page carries no reuse terms; Fastned Terms of Use (en-gb terms-conditions) are readable and contain no clause on reuse of site data; the UK Open Data / API Fair Use policy covers only UK charge point and tariff data, not vehicle charge graphs, so no licence for the graphs exists either way (owner confirms). Same graph data is on the Fastned Volvo XC40 Recharge 78 kWh (2020-2023) and C40 Recharge 78 kWh pages.
